intro: Hacienda Heights is a Rough Hollow section known for Spanish influenced architecture. CleanzATX cleans the arched, divided and deep set windows here, and soft washes the stucco around them.

paragraphs: Hacienda Heights is a small section of Rough Hollow where the architecture leans Spanish. Think stucco walls, clay or tile style roofs, arched openings and iron details. Prices run from about $800K to $1.5M. It is not gated, and the Rough Hollow HOA applies.

The style shapes the glass. Windows are often set deep into thick walls, some are arched at the top, and many are divided into smaller panes by grilles. That means more edges, more corners and more to clean per window.

sections.h2: What Hacienda Heights windows deal with
paragraphs: Divided lites collect dirt along every grille bar, and arch tops hold water that runs down in a streak. Deep sills keep dust and pollen, then funnel rain into a line across the lower pane. Stucco chalk and fine grit wash off the wall and onto the glass.

Sprinkler water is another culprit. It leaves hard water rings on lower panes and splashes dirt onto the stucco. We clean every small pane by hand along the grilles, and hard water spot removal is $10 per pane.

Water fed poles with soft brushes get into the corners, and we hand finish any stubborn spots on the edges. Stucco is soft washed, never blasted, from $0.20 per sq ft with a $400 minimum, which protects the finish and the paint. Tile and pavers are handled gently too.

A 3,200 sq ft home with divided glass is about $320 for exterior windows, which takes around two and a half hours outside. Those smaller panes are counted by window, at $10 a window or $5 a pane. Quotes come by text, usually inside the hour.

faq.q: How do you price divided windows?
faq.a: Exterior windows are $10 each, or $5 per pane for those with separate panes. Text the count or a photo and we confirm the total, with a $200 minimum job.

faq.q: Will soft washing hurt my stucco paint?
faq.a: No. Soft washing uses low pressure and a cleaning solution that lifts algae and dirt. It is the right method for stucco and roofs, and for limestone.

faq.q: Do you clean tile style roofs?
faq.a: We soft wash roofs from $0.25 per sq ft with a $400 minimum. We look at the material first and tell you whether we recommend it.

faq.q: Can you reach the arched windows high on the front?
faq.a: Yes. Poles reach up to three stories from the ground and can brush into the arches.

faq.q: Is there a difference between a clean and a restoration?
faq.a: Yes. A cleaning removes dirt and spots. Deeply etched glass will not look new, and we will say so before starting.
